meta_title: Instawarm Gas & Heating | Gas Engineer Newcastle
meta_description: Instawarm Gas & Central Heating Services offer Gas Safe registered engineers in Newcastle. Boiler installs, repairs & servicing. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Boilers, Heating & Emergencies
hero_subhead: Boiler broken or heating failing? Instawarm's Gas Safe engineers are ready to restore your warmth fast — no fuss, no hidden costs.
services_heading: Complete Gas & Central Heating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full central heating installations, Instawarm covers every gas and heating need for Newcastle homeowners and landlords.

services.title: Boiler Repair
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of all boiler makes and models, getting your heating and hot water back on as quickly as possible. We carry a wide range of common parts so most repairs are completed on the first visit.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Expert supply and installation of energy-efficient boilers tailored to your home's requirements. We'll advise on the best system for your budget and ensure a clean, fully compliant installation.

services.title: Annual Boiler Servicing
services.desc: A thorough annual service keeps your boiler running safely, efficiently, and within manufacturer warranty terms. Regular servicing also helps catch small issues before they become costly breakdowns.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full design and installation of central heating systems for new builds, extensions, and full home upgrades. We work neatly and efficiently, minimising disruption to your home.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates (CP12)
services.desc: Landlord gas safety inspections and CP12 certificates carried out by Gas Safe registered engineers. We help you stay legally compliant and protect your tenants year after year.

services.title: Radiator & Thermostat Upgrades
services.desc: Improve comfort and cut energy bills with new radiators, thermostatic radiator valves, and smart thermostat installations. Small upgrades can make a significant difference to heating efficiency and control.

about_pullquote: Every customer deserves warmth, honesty, and a job done right first time.
about_para_1: Instawarm Gas & Central Heating Services was founded to bring straightforward, reliable gas engineering to homes and properties across Newcastle upon Tyne. Based in Holystone, NE7, our Gas Safe registered engineers combine genuine local knowledge with up-to-date technical training to deliver work you can trust.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on transparent pricing, tidy workmanship, and making sure every customer is happy before we leave. Whether you're a homeowner facing a breakdown or a landlord managing multiple properties, Instawarm offers the professional, no-nonsense service that keeps Newcastle homes warm and safe.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Instawarm

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on a cold Tuesday morning and Instawarm had an engineer with us by early afternoon. Very professional, explained exactly what the fault was, and had it fixed within the hour. Reasonably priced too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Used Instawarm for our annual boiler service and were really impressed. The engineer was punctual, polite, and clearly knew his stuff. He spotted a small issue we weren't aware of and sorted it on the spot. Great local company.
reviews.author: Michael R.

reviews.text: Had a full central heating system installed by Instawarm and couldn't be happier. The team were tidy, efficient, and kept us informed throughout. Everything works perfectly and the finish is excellent. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Susan H.
